subtitle97: Review payments and resolve exceptions by sale.
noDouble97: An integrated payment and its receipt count only once.
noSettlement97: Receipt review does not confirm bank settlement.
cashSales97: Cash sales only; opening float and movements belong to the official till calculation.
provisionalHelp97: Associating a receipt helps investigation but does not confirm a payment or clear closing without review. Confirm provisional association?
filtersHelp97: Show all sales to review those already checked.
emptyHelp97: Refresh the list. Incomplete data keeps totals unknown.
exportError97: Could not download the reconciliation. Try again.
partial97: Data is incomplete or unavailable. A dash is not zero; exceptions are not cleared automatically.
local97: This reconciliation is local. Official closing requires the till response.
invalidSource97: The sales data could not be validated. Refresh before closing.
invalidEvidence97: This link does not match a valid payment. Void the incorrect receipt and record reviewed data.
duplicate97: Repeated reference for the same terminal and provider. Review before continuing.
unassigned97: Receipt not yet linked to a sale.
confirmMatch97: Have you checked reference, amount and sale? Confirm this payment link?
confirmUnlink97: Unlink this receipt? Its data will remain for review.
confirmDiscard97: Discard the unrecorded fields of this receipt?
readingHelp97: Each reading replaces amount, date, method and reference. Check empty fields; previous values are not reused.
reviewNote97: The note records local review; it does not replace server permissions or closing rules.
finalHelp97: Review counted cash and exceptions. Official balance and variance come from the till confirmation.
